notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken white creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving the nontoken white creature persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the white creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering its persist ability, returining it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
